in_sanskrit.name: Sharunn
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Love, Compassion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sharunn एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Sharunn is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘shara’, meaning ‘king’, and the Sanskrit word ‘rani’, meaning ‘queen’. It represents the love and compassion that a queen or king shows towards their subjects. It is a beautiful name for a girl who is expected to rule with love and compassion.
